servesPizza.name: That's Amore Italian Cafe
servesPizza.note: An Italian restaurant and cafe on Mount Baker Ridge known for pasta and classic Italian fare; its menu includes a dedicated pizza section with six wood-style pies such as Margherita, Pepperoni, Roma, and Vegetali.

servesPizza.name: Hatback Bar & Grille
servesPizza.note: A sports bar and grille near the SoDo stadiums serving burgers, wings, and Pacific Northwest seafood; pizza is one of its game-day menu items alongside those dishes.
